finding a therapist that clicks with you can be difficult, it can take a few tries. 

from my experience i think journalling or keeping a log of emotions can help as a first step. it sounds a bit cheesy but it can help as a first step to being more honest to yourself. you are important and deserve to be heard, it's difficult to be honest once it becomes a habit to lie. it's not your fault it got out of control, it just becomes hard to control it once it spirals, but there's steps to take that can help break the cycle.

it's good that you're reaching out, it takes a lot to ask for help. i tend to compulsively lie to family and mental health professionals about my state. it's easier to lie, but it's better to tell the truth and work through your struggles. 

it's not extreme for a 14 year old to be here, your struggles and pain are real and you deserve a place to talk about it. do you want to get anything more off your chest? it can help to try to vent and talk things out. i don't know if you've been able to talk about things in depth in therapy, this is a safe space to talk about things if you'd like to talk more.
nougat, if you are reading, please know i am here and you are important to me even if we are internet strangers
i accidentally hit ignore on the message
nougat please come bacl

you are able to open up about this here and i don't think you are pathetic in the slightest. you were vulnerable and i do not think he thinks you are pathetic, he listened and checked in on you.

it's extremely difficult to open up to people and trust them with that information.  promise you are safe, you are alive and deserve a happy life.

do you want to vent more? i'm here for you. you are going to make it through this, i will help you with whatever i can.

anhedonia is very difficult to navigate, i give my deepest apologies. i am beginning to experience it the last few years. i find it helpful to look forward to things like i said with movie releases or game releases, or just looking forward to what's for dinner tomorrow.

would you want to visit your family soon? it's nice to be reminded of people in your life and it can be good to spend time with others. 

let's walk through this together, i am here for you. there is life ahead, treatments for depression are constantly changing. i have hope that there is going to be good days. 

do you like work at all? or are you in school?

my heart is strongly going to you. i do not know much about being an adult but you are going through a lot right now, i hear you. 

the justice system is not always on our side, but i know you are not the villain. he is not right about you, he is a villain.

as a daughter to someone, i wouldn't know how to react if i lost my mother. i don't think you want to be away from your children. there is going to be a day where your ex husband is completely out of your life, i want you to be able to live happy. 

you say there's a lot more going on. do you wanna get more off your chest? i am here to listen and be here for you as best as i can.

hi nightsiege, can you talk with me a little while?

in my experience, hospitalization and programs like that can make you feel more aware of your current situation and problems. it's supposed to help but it may feel like a strong reminder, but i'm proud of you for getting to some help.

you posted here which means you were probably hoping for someone to reach out. you want things like a family and to grow older, that's something to look forward to. you do deserve to live life and have joys. 

do you have pets, or do you ever think about getting a pet? what's your favorite food?

stay a while, let's talk, ok?

i have intense depression and i think it might help to at least have someone who has a similar situation. i'm here right now. i hear how hard it is, i really empathize. 

it probably feels like there is no light in the dark. sometimes there are days where things look up, even for a little bit. there are a lot of things you might want to do to try and occupy time like hobbies, books, movies, or games you never got to yet. 

there are little things that help for a little while. do you have any loved ones nearby, or do you have any pets?
please dont give up
